svg.title: Madagascar: same54 route scenarios, two coastline products
svg.desc: Coastline-dependent clearance diagnoses map support. Neither land mask verifies a current axis, shelf/slope correspondence, current endpoints, seasonal geometry or safe navigation.
svg.text: Madagascar: same 54 route scenarios, two coastlines
Blue dashed: coastal experiment. Orange dotted: offshore alternative. Vertices unchanged.
Land clearance is a map check; no current axis, width or seasonal range is admitted.
Coastal: 27 of27 scenarios contact this land mask.
Offshore: 0 of27 scenarios contact this land mask.
Coastal: 27 of27 scenarios contact this land mask.
Offshore: 0 of27 scenarios contact this land mask.
Natural Earth public-domain land; 1:10 million is a map scale, not 10-metre accuracy. OSW comparison; not a navigation chart.
Both panels use the same equirectangular projection and unchanged route vertices.
